title: NewStewForYou
description: Feed Suspicious Stew to Villagers to Clear Bed, Workstation, Bell.  Click Nitwits with Blaze Rod to de-nitwit them or a block of iron to turn them into a golem.
body:
🥣 New Stew for You
A second chance for your villagers — and your Nitwits.

This lightweight Fabric mod adds three powerful villager interactions using vanilla items, no new blocks or recipes required.

🔧 How It Works
🧠 Feed a Villager Suspicious Stew
→ Clears their bed, job site, meeting point (bell), and gossip.
→ Great for giving villagers a clean slate — no need to use commands or wait for memory decay.
✅ Works on all adult villagers except Nitwits.

🔥 Right-click a Nitwit with a Blaze Rod
→ Converts them into an unemployed villager, allowing them to pick a profession.
→ Plays happy particles and consumes the item.

🛡️ Right-click a Nitwit with a Block of Iron
→ Transforms the Nitwit into an Iron Golem.
→ A final act of redemption for your most hopeless villagers.

🧪 Features
Uses only vanilla items: Suspicious Stew, Blaze Rod, Block of Iron.

Includes sound and particle effects.

All interactions are server-side only — clients do not need the mod.

Designed for Fabric and tested with Minecraft 1.21.4.
